item.banya_hat.desc: A felt cap: the head keeps cool in the steam room.
item.banya_hat.name: Banya hat
item.banya_towel.desc: A terry towel. A rub-down after the ice hole and you're warm at once.
item.banya_towel.name: Towel
item.birch_venik.desc: A bunch of birch twigs steeped in hot water. Good for one banya day.
item.birch_venik.name: Birch venik
item.carrot.desc: A carrot. You can eat it, or give a snowman a nose.
item.carrot.name: Carrot
item.coal.desc: Two bits of coal from the banya stove. Just right for a snowman's eyes.
item.coal.name: Bits of coal
item.skates.desc: «Snegurochka» leisure skates on leather boots. Put them on and go to the pond.
item.skates.name: Skates
winter.radio.new_year: Happy New Year, Lyudmilovsk! The walruses wait for everyone brave by the pier until one o'clock.
winter.radio.rink_open: The rink on the seaside park's pond is open: the ice is {0} centimetres. Skates at the department store's sports counter.
winter.radio.rink_slush: A thaw: there is water over the ice at the park rink, and the rink is closed.
winter.radio.rink_thin: The ice on the park pond is still thin, {0} centimetres. Please keep off it.
winter.radio.walrus: The walruses' club invites you: tomorrow at nine, a swim in the ice hole by the pier. The banya by the pier is heated from two.
